source_references.title: KFC UK & Ireland operational update: The Colonel is working on it

snapshot_material.root_episode: KFC UK and Ireland fresh-chicken delivery disruption operational update
facts: A disruption involving the new delivery partner made it difficult to get fresh chicken to KFC's 900 restaurants; 900 is delivery scope, not an affected-restaurant count.
KFC stated that it would not compromise its fresh-chicken quality standard.
Some restaurants were closed, operating limited menus, or on shortened hours.
Unspecified teams were working to restore operations.
snapshot_material.owner_authority: The public-channel publisher owns the same-day update; the named operational recovery owner is not established.
unknowns: Individual restaurant states, affected count, geography, duration, and recovery timing are not established.
No named recovery owner, approved public status route, or later outcome is established.
transformation_redaction_log: Preserved the distinction between 900-restaurant delivery scope and affected-restaurant count.
Excluded later apology creative, recovery, and retrospective outcome material.
Kept individual status and recovery details explicitly unknown.
snapshot_material.curator_attestation: No repository, framework, skill, evaluation, routing, or failure-taxonomy context was available.

source_references.title: Impact Dialing founder interview case narrative (title sealed from executor)

snapshot_material.root_episode: Impact Dialing's two-week PPC test for commercial customers
facts: The test generated 263 clicks, 48.86 percent bounce, 6.08 percent account creation, 0.0076 percent paid conversion, and an 862 dollar CPA.
Calls and site chat indicated that commercial prospects wanted capabilities the product did not provide.
The immediate evidence did not isolate ad setup, landing-page copy, or the PPC channel as the sole cause.
snapshot_material.owner_authority: CEO and founder Michael Kaiser-Nyman controlled the campaign decision and influenced product priorities.
unknowns: The specific missing capabilities, their feasibility, segment economics, and keyword-level results were not disclosed.
The trade-publication account was not an independently audited causal analysis.
transformation_redaction_log: Retained reported metrics and feedback mechanism while withholding the historical decision from the executor-visible snapshot.
Compressed ad variants and omitted prospect identities and unspecified feature requests.
Excluded later expectations as post-decision evidence.
snapshot_material.curator_attestation: No repository, framework, skill, evaluation, routing, or failure-taxonomy context was available.
